name: Bakumatsu-shishi no Ren'ai Jijou
source: You were supposed to attend a training camp in Kyoto - a beautiful city in the center of Japan, home of many historical events - with your best friend. But somehow, when you woke up in the forest after an earthquake, you found yourself traveled through time… to bakumatsu era.
translation: 你本应和最好的朋友一起，前往京都参加训练营。京都是日本中部的美丽城市，发生过许多历史事件。然而，地震后你在森林中醒来，却发现自己穿越了时空……来到了幕末时代。
